summary: JUDGING. I checked all three drafts against the digests (2,127 quest rows indexed), the TUGs Horde .lua files, and an XP simulation that uses the Classic XP curve, +35-50% XP from mob kills and reduced XP for quests 6+ levels below you. (1) tugs-faithful: 8/10. It is closest to TUGs' order, and each dungeon block is replaced near the spot TUGs already sends you. Its XP maths is honest (about 1.35M short at +35%). Weak points: segment 4 (13-17) packs the Barrens and a cross-continent return to Undercity into one block, and the Mage's Wand chain sits late at 43+ when it can start at 30. (2) travel-min: 7/10. Good continent-block and Teleport logic, and it correctly picks up 1959 in Orgrimmar at 15. But it pushes the level 14-18 Silverpine quests (423/424/479/443/446/460) to level 21-24, where they give reduced XP. It also overstates the total documented quest XP (about 2.4M; the real figure is about 2.0M) and its forecast end level. (3) xp-density: 6/10. It uses 6562 (in the Blackfathom Deeps digest) and 1489/1490 (in the Wailing Caverns digest), which breaks the no-dungeon rule. It assumes 40-70% kill XP instead of the stated 30-40%. Good parts kept from it: starting the wand chain at 30-38, the 92401 and 98389 cautions, and the Shen'dralas placement. All three drafts are clean on Alliance zones. Wetlands and Loch Modan are only crossed on TUGs' Arathi to Badlands run. FINAL PLAN: one guide in 19 segments with tugs-faithful as the backbone. Levels 1-30 follow TUGs' Forever files and 30-60 follow TUGs' Classic part files. Each dungeon block becomes open-world questing in the same area TUGs is already in. Ragefire Chasm and the Ruins of Lordaeron become the Undercity/Silverpine second pass with the Spellfire Robes. Wailing Caverns becomes the central Barrens, eastern Stonetalon and the Magatha/Zamah chain. Shadowfang Keep becomes the Sepulcher plus the first Tarren Mill visit. Blackfathom Deeps becomes Sun Rock/Windshear plus all of Ashenvale. The Excavation Site, Razorfen Kraul and Gnomeregan become the Shimmering Flats plus northern Stranglethorn. City of Dalaran becomes Alterac and Hammerfall. I validated every quest ID in the main line: none is in a DUNGEON digest, none is flagged ELITE (ELITE ones appear only as named skips), and none is missing from the digest. Segment ends chain exactly. HONEST XP: the main line holds about 2.0M quest XP. With +35-50% from kills, that is roughly on schedule to 36 (at most about 0.5-1 level behind). After that it runs short by about 1.0-1.3M XP, roughly 6-7 levels of grinding spread over 37-60. TUGs' own Classic files grind at the same points (Badlands elementals, STV trolls, Feralas, Blasted Lands, Searing Gorge, Azshara, Un'Goro, EPL). The Riverglades detour slot at about 37 (after segment 13) is placed exactly where that gap opens. The logger should measure the real share of XP from kills, since mage AoE questing usually beats 35%.

riverglades: The main line does not depend on Riverglades. Its slot is right after segment 13 (Dustwallow & Stranglethorn II, ending around level 36.6-37 at Grom'gol) and before segment 14. That is where the documented route starts running short. Segments 14-16 are each about 0.8-1.1 levels short, roughly 300k XP combined, and the Riverglades level band (35-45) covers exactly that range. How to run it: arrive with 10 or fewer open quests (carry only 1183, 1116, 1106, 1261, 1436, 701/678 and 507). Bind your hearth at Rog'mar. Use Teleport: Orgrimmar/Undercity for training and turn-ins, and the Brill trip for the mount at 40. Stay while its quests are no more than 2-3 levels above you, and let the logger record every accept and turn-in. Leave at about 41-43. If you leave at 41+, skip the lowest parts of segments 14-15, which will have gone green: Faldir's Cove 663-668, Badlands 710/703/1419/2258 and Swamp 1418/698/1392. Go straight to Stonard, then Booty Bay, then segment 16. Entry: if Rog'mar is on Kalimdor (possibly near TUGs' new Mulgore 40,17.2 to Desolace passage), Teleport: Thunder Bluff from Grom'gol and walk in, then come back by Teleport: Undercity to start segment 14. If it is in the Eastern Kingdoms near Hillsbrad/Arathi, enter it from Tarren Mill or Hammerfall at the start of segment 14 instead. Shen'dralas (19 NEW quests, levels 38-43, needs level 35, ~40k XP, no giver data; its quest names point to the southern Desolace / Feralas border) fits the same 37-43 window as a smaller second filler. Look for its givers at the end of segment 12. Mount Hyjal has no data at all. If it opens as a 55-60 zone, it should replace the grinding in segments 18-19. Once the logger has recorded these zones, re-cut segments 14-19.
openQuestions: Does Forever keep the Classic mage spell timing (Teleport: Undercity/Orgrimmar at 20, Teleport: Thunder Bluff at 30, Portals at 40/50, Rune of Teleportation reagent)? Every continent switch from segment 7 on assumes it. Also, what is 97286 Research Access (NEW, mage, level 20)?
Mount: is it still level 40 in Brill, and what do riding and the horse cost? The Classic total is about 90-100g.

What share of XP comes from kills in practice? The logger should measure it. The plan assumes +35-50%, which leaves about 1.0-1.3M XP (6-7 levels) of grinding over 37-60 if Riverglades is skipped. Mage AoE questing may beat this.

Should the route files contain explicit grind steps (e.g. 'grind to 39 at the Badlands rock elementals', following TUGs' own Classic grind lines), or wait for the logger's XP rates before adding them?
Is 92401 A Frightened Request (4,600 XP, given at the Sepulcher) completed outdoors, or inside the Ruins of Lordaeron? TUGs does it during the Ruins run.
Can you take the north-Mulgore level 30 hub (96259/96241/96260/96294, plus 96774 Ancient Gurubashi Idol) without the Excavation Site dungeon breadcrumb 95664 -> 98823?
City of Dalaran (96984-96988, 9,400 XP each) is in its own digest file but not flagged DUNGEON. TUGs runs it as a group instance, so the plan excludes it. Can it be done solo or in the open world?
1361 Regthar Deathgate: TUGs accepts it in Orgrimmar, but the digest says Krusk in Tarren Mill. Which is right in Forever? Is TUGs' Thunder Bluff -> Mulgore 40,17.2 -> Desolace path a new land route?

98389 A Light in the Darkness is in the Undead-mage digest but TUGs marks it Paladin-only. 1959 Report to Anastasia is listed only from Uthel'nay (Orgrimmar). Confirm that both are correct for an Undead mage.

Are any ELITE-flagged quests soloable by a mage a few levels higher, so they could replace grinding? Candidates: 95885 The Offering of Blood, 1150/1151 Freewind tests (they unlock Test of Lore), 6641 Vorsha, 1955 The Exorcism, 3452 The Flame's Casing, 5153.

Will the player use the Auction House for item-gated quests (Badlands 713-716 parts, STV Green Hills pages, Jade for 1948 Items of Power), and which professions do they want? Skinning helps with mount gold. Tailoring reduces the cloth left for the level-60 cloth-donation quests.
